schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema this file is written in.

id.title: Species id
id.description: S and two digits, unique on the server. A mibi a player keeps is M and four digits.

name.title: Name
name.description: The species' name, once it has a cleared one.

plan.title: Body plan
plan.description: The body plan: it fixes the spine's ranges, the head attachment and the limits.

plan_version.title: Plan version
plan_version.description: The version of the plan this file was made against.

anchors.title: Anchors
anchors.description: How wide each group may vary between individuals. Body and face are always tight.

length.title: Length
length.description: The range's length along the spine; the last range runs to the end.

ranges.title: Ranges
ranges.description: The spine's named ranges, in the plan's order, with their lengths.

a.title: Head spine reach
a.description: How far in from the back of the head's depth the spine ends.

d.title: Head overhang
d.description: How far forward of the spine axis the head's centre lies.

z_under.title: Head underside
z_under.description: The height of the head's underside, where the spine ends.

head_attach.title: Head attachment
head_attach.description: Where the head sits on the spine. The kind is the plan's.

radius.title: Seat radius
radius.description: The seat's radius; the tail's root is measured against it.

length.title: Tail length
length.description: The tail's length along its path; its segments keep their shares.

root.title: Tail root
root.description: The root's radius as a share of the seat's radius.

tip_r.title: Tail tip radius
tip_r.description: The radius at the stalk's end.

root_at.title: Tail root place
root_at.description: Where the tail leaves the seat.

share.title: Share
share.description: The segment's share of the tail's length.

r.title: Radius
r.description: The segment's radius at its start and end.

segments.title: Tail segments
segments.description: The tail's bends, root to tip: each keeps a share of the length.

fillet.title: Tail roundness
fillet.description: The path's fillet at the tail's bends.

turns.title: Curl
turns.description: Turns of curl at the type.

spread.title: Curl spread
spread.description: How the curl is spread along the bends.

clip.title: Curl clip
clip.description: The room rule that clips it.

taper.title: Tail taper
taper.description: How the tail thins (monotone by construction).

end.title: Tail end
end.description: How the tail's end is capped.

tail.title: Tail
tail.description: The tail range of the spine.

R_scale.title: Head size
R_scale.description: The head ball's size, as a share of the base table's.

neck_ratio.title: Neck width
neck_ratio.description: The neck band's radius over the head ball's.

chest_front.title: Chest swell
chest_front.description: How far the chest's front swells out under the neck band.

rump_gain.title: Seat fullness
rump_gain.description: How far the back swells at the seat, under the tail.

head_profile.title: Profile
head_profile.description: The knobs that shape the loft's section table: the head ball, the neck band, the chest and the rump. The table is worked out from these and is never edited.

loft.title: Spine loft
loft.description: The loft's profile knobs, and the section table and mesh topology that travel with them (the table is derived from the knobs; the topology is the plan's, until it owns it).

spine.title: Spine
spine.description: One path and one loft from the crown to the tail tip, named in ranges.

chest.title: Chest joint
chest.description: The chest joint, on the back range.

pelvis.title: Pelvis joint
pelvis.description: The pelvis joint, in the seat range.

hip.title: Hip joint
hip.description: Where the leg's root is taken from.

chest_at.title: Chest joint on the back
chest_at.description: A quadruped's chest joint: where on the back range it stands, 0 at the neck and 1 at the seat.

pelvis_at.title: Pelvis joint on the seat
pelvis_at.description: A quadruped's pelvis joint: where on the seat range it stands, 0 at the back and 1 at the tail.

shoulder_off.title: Shoulder offset
shoulder_off.description: A quadruped's shoulder: where the foreleg's root is from the chest joint (x forward, y outward, z up).

hip_off.title: Hip offset
hip_off.description: A quadruped's hip: where the hind leg's root is from the pelvis joint (x forward, y outward, z up).

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.description: The girdles that anchor the limbs.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: A limb has a chain of joints; an appendage has families.

join.title: Join
join.description: Hard: a separate shell sunk in. Soft: it grows out of the parent's skin. Nothing in between.

spec.title: Socket details
spec.description: Patch, columns, push and the rest of the socket's numbers.

socket.title: Socket
socket.description: Where and how the part joins its parent.

root.title: Root joint
root.description: A limb's root joint: where it is, its radius and its role.

r.title: Radius
r.description: The segment's radius at its start and end.

apex.title: Bend side
apex.description: Which way the joint bends (fwd or back).

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: A limb's joints after the root, each with its length, pitch and radius.

families.title: Families
families.description: An appendage's families and their joints.

default.title: Default look
default.description: The family a new individual starts with.

family.title: Family reference
family.description: A reference into the body plan.

topology.title: Mesh topology
topology.description: Rings, edge length and the rest of the part's topology (the plan will own them).

end.title: End
end.description: How the part's end is capped.

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: The plane the chain bends in.

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: The limbs and appendages, each on a socket.

spec.title: Socket details
spec.description: On, station, frame, families, default and shapes.

sockets.title: Sockets
sockets.description: Where attachments grow: each declares a join and the families it allows.

material.title: Material
material.description: The material family and its limits.

catalogue.title: Catalogue pin
catalogue.description: The catalogue this frame is valid against: id, version and content digest.

clan.title: Clan
clan.description: The species' clan: its branch records are open to it.

borrows.title: Borrowed records
borrows.description: Branch records of another clan this species lists.

chapters.title: Chapters
chapters.description: The chapters the loci are grouped in.

loci.title: Loci
loci.description: Each locus: kind, op, limits, type, bins and moves (typed paths into this file).

genome.title: Genome
genome.description: The game's species frame: the catalogue pin, the chapters, and each locus with its kind, pool, limits, type and the typed paths it moves.

expressions.title: Expressions
expressions.description: The looks the species can draw with their rules: the age a look shows from and the other looks it needs (checked in expressions.py; how copies show is the catalogue's, or a modifier gene's).

variety.title: Variety
variety.description: The Variety sheet's rules: how many individuals, the seed, the loci whose looks cycle, the most loud looks one individual shows, and the species rules as data: {id, label, when: [conditions], then: [conditions], fail}. A condition is {field, is | not | in: [lo, hi]} or {any: [conditions]}.

renders.title: Renders
renders.description: The render set: {base: 'game-v1', add: {name: {size, style, az, pose, age, kind, from, genome}}}. A species adds to the game's set and never removes from it.

play.title: Play
play.description: What play may change: {toys: [{id, label, hide, narrow}], words: {check: sentence}, state: {gene: value}, starter, name}. A species may relabel a toy, hide it or narrow it, never widen it; `state` is the mibi's own setting of each toy and `name` its own name (checked in wb/play.py).

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Walk, breathe, blink and idle clips.

balance_margin.title: Balance margin
balance_margin.description: Share of the sole in front of the heel.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: Overrides of the plan's limits. A file may only tighten them, never loosen.

legacy.title: Legacy
legacy.description: Fields the schema does not model yet and carries unchanged: the house, the frame, the mesh quality numbers, the poles, the appendage rules, the part order.
